PIT@NO.text: Steelers S DeShon Elliott is back from injured reserve for Sunday's game.

CIN@BAL.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is ruled out with a high ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley starts.

CLE@TEN.text: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins is expected back from an ankle injury after missing Week 6.

IND@MIN.text: Colts CB Sauce Gardner (calf) and TE Tyler Warren (groin) are out against the Vikings.

MIA@NYJ.text: Jets RB Breece Hall is questionable and reportedly unlikely to play against Miami.

NYG@HOU.text: J.J. McCarthy starts at quarterback for the Giants, replacing Jameis Winston.

SF@ATL.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (Achilles) and DE Nick Bosa (calf) are both out against Atlanta.

TB@CAR.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield is expected to start after missing three games with a dislocated thumb.

DEN@ARI.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love is out with an ankle injury against the Broncos.

GB@DET.text: Josh Jacobs is back for the Packers after missing six games on the commissioner's exempt list.

LA@LV.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua is questionable for Sunday with a calf injury.

KC@SEA.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice is out for a second straight week with hamstring and knee injuries.

DAL@PHI.text: Tanner McKee starts at QB for the Eagles with Jalen Hurts sidelined by blood clots.

CAR@GB.text: Packers EDGE Micah Parsons and C Sean Rhyan won't be available Thursday against Carolina.

ARI@DAL.text: CeeDee Lamb is torching everybody: 651 yards and six TDs. Arizona's secondary is next on the menu.

ATL@TB.text: Baker's thumb is fine: he just ran Carolina off the field. Bucs WR Emeka Egbuka (concussion, foot) is questionable.

BAL@BUF.text: Lamar's expected back for the Ravens, but by his own words he's "not even close" to his full capability. Bills, take note.

CLE@PIT.text: Revenge game: Cleveland beat Pittsburgh in Week 5 while Aaron Rodgers threw two picks. The Steelers want that one back.

IND@JAX.text: Trevor Lawrence finally woke up: two recent 300-yard games and 14 TD passes, tied for fourth-most in the league.

LV@NYJ.text: Kirk Cousins leads the NFL with 16 TD passes. Yes, that Kirk Cousins. Rookie Fernando Mendoza keeps waiting.

MIN@DET.text: The Lions are 1-4-1 against the spread, and Vegas has them laying a field goal at home again anyway.

TEN@CIN.text: Joe Burrow (15 TDs, 3 INTs) is in the MVP chat. The Titans are in the worst-team-in-football chat.

LAC@LA.text: Justin Herbert ranks dead last in adjusted EPA per play. Puka Nacua gets fed while Davante Adams is out.

KC@DEN.text: Denver's offense ranks 29th in success rate, and Seattle held Kenneth Walker to 36 rushing yards last week. Pass the popcorn.

NE@MIA.text: Drake Maye has been quietly fantastic, and Miami is without De'Von Achane. The Dolphins are getting a touchdown at home.

PHI@WAS.text: The Eagles are without their franchise QB, and Jayden Daniels is still hunting his first win. Somebody's gotta win this.

CHI@SEA.text: The Bears are an NFL-best 5-2 against the spread and have covered every game Caleb Williams started and finished.
